name: operations.swaps

list.description: Read full native swap orders within the verified inquiry scope.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Inclusive native trade-date start YYYY-MM-DD; both ordered bounds are required.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Inclusive native trade-date end YYYY-MM-DD, at or after from-date.

purpose: Inspect native swap orders through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: dealId
fields.meaning: Native Deal ID; orderId and hedgeOrderId remain separate references.

fields.name: tradeDate
fields.meaning: Native YYYYMMDD trade date selected by the source query.

fields.name: nearLegValueDate
fields.meaning: Independent native near-leg YYYYMMDD date or null/blank.

fields.name: farLegValueDate
fields.meaning: Independent native far-leg YYYYMMDD date or null/blank.

identity_description: Native dealId identifies one swap document within the tenant and exact acquisition scope; greatest validated native integer gmtModified selects its complete observed version.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant. POST form /swapOrderQuery.json contains a serialized swapOrderQueryVO with fixed empty near-leg entity arrays and blank near/far leg date bounds.
Required ISO trade-date bounds map to inclusive native YYYYMMDD bounds. Unbounded acquisition and other filters are unsupported. No source timezone is inferred.
Absolute rowStart offsets use pageSize=1000; records are result.swapOrderVOList and native total is result.count. Near/far dates are independent fields, not extra queries or computed tenors.
Preserve complete native JSON, nested values, unknown fields, nullable/grouped decimal strings, native integers and boolean flags. No leg join, rate conversion or detail enrichment.

gmtModified is required on every row and compared as a native integer without epoch-unit or timezone inference. Missing, null, boolean, fractional or string ordering values fail; original timestamps and full chosen records are preserved.

The host SDK owns retries, completeness and publication. Declared latest_by selects the complete native row with greatest required integer gmtModified for each dealId; equal-order differing rows use last arrival with a warning. Valid selection is accepted in default and strict modes when traversal is complete. Native counts and actual coverage gaps remain separate; rejected refresh preserves the prior capture. Widths are historical successful request sizes, not measured backend maxima.
